designation: POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC; retrospective, not confirmatory preregistration before STEP5C results
questions: H5 topology discontinuity versus stable-topology failure
universe: converged Domain A, six X elements only; BASELINE excluded from all four eta2 comparisons; every state counted once; no Ni/Anchor/Domain B materialized

variance.interpretation: descriptive association with identity; within-element variance not causal attribution to composition/T
variance.sensitivity: composition-equal weighting, each composition total weight 1 despite missing temperature states

distances.scaler: five training X identities; population std; zero std replaced by 1 with flag
distances.range: strict numeric bounds with 1e-10 absolute tolerance
distances.svd: center five standardized anchors; rank tol=max(shape)*eps*smax; residual=norm(z-projection); normalized= residual/max(norm(z),1e-12)
distances.convex: SLSQP nonnegative weights sum=1; ftol=1e-12; maxiter=2000; verify KKT/projection optimality
distances.composition: reuse immutable STEP5C distances, no recomputation or property changes
distances.f3: all F3 ever selected; training ranges exclude heldout and BASELINE; frozen candidate features only

archetypes.centroids: overall, each exact Temperature_C, and X_wt_pct low/mid/high using fold-train composition terciles
archetypes.borrowing: argmin TVD(predicted centroid, each FOLD_TRAIN element centroid); canonical element order breaks ties
archetypes.js: base-2 Jensen-Shannon divergence, not square-root distance
archetypes.topology: argmax five-family vector, canonical family order breaks ties
archetypes.entropy: Shannon bits over empirical dominant-family frequencies

boundary.transition: change between consecutive full-grid observed temperatures for same composition; midpoint boundary; never bridge missing states
boundary.distance: minimum absolute grid-index distance to transition midpoint; <=1 adjacent, >1 stable; no observed transitions -> no-observed-transition group; incomplete trajectory flagged
boundary.conditioning: exact heldout x temperature x topology_correctness strata with both split categories; overlap-weight min(n_split,n_nonsplit); descriptive standardized contrast; no causal claim

models.scope: X partition only, all six folds identical, original selected features; no feature reselection; existing tree predictions only
models.projection: clip negative outputs and renormalize, zero sum fallback frozen FOLD_TRAIN mean

ridge.selection: minimum projected validation mean TVD; ties <=1e-12 choose smaller alpha

mlp.early_stopping: minimum raw validation MSE, min_delta=1e-8; restore best epoch
mlp.lr_selection: minimum projected validation TVD; ties <=1e-12 choose smaller LR
mlp.data: all eligible train/validation rows, no subsampling
mlp.device: CUDA if available else CPU; deterministic torch algorithms; fixed seed per fold reset for each LR

models.analog: 13-property nearest training element, FOLD_TRAIN mean X-partition by exact temperature; no heldout targets
models.freeze: save all six model selections before diagnostic heldout scoring

metrics: trivial minus model TVD (original STEP5C skill convention)

detection.high_error: TVD >= pooled empirical 90th percentile, include ties; report achieved prevalence; within-fold 90th percentile sensitivity
detection.constant: constant scores -> AUROC .5, AP prevalence; report NO_WITHIN_FOLD_RESOLUTION
detection.disagreement: only if two frozen pre-scoring alternative artifacts exist; do not train or infer missing alternatives

inferential_limits: all n=6 element correlations exploratory, report rho without p-values; rows clustered by composition; no causal identification or proof of descriptor sufficiency/necessity

go_no_go.proceed: all source hashes match; no forbidden rows; finite simplex targets; exact split isolation; all six validation selections frozen before heldout scoring
go_no_go.stop: source changes, forbidden rows, missing core input, failed leakage or numeric integrity
go_no_go.tree_bias_support: same smooth model achieves >=0.05 absolute TVD gain AND >=0.10 absolute topology accuracy gain over tree in >=4 folds
go_no_go.rescue: positive skill vs trivial AND topology accuracy >=0.5 in >=4 folds for same smooth model
go_no_go.topology_support: >=80% aggregate summed X TVD from topology-wrong states
go_no_go.boundary_support: adjacent minus stable mean TVD >=0.05 in >=4 folds with both groups; otherwise no general boundary support
go_no_go.sparsity: five independent identity anchors documented; causal role not experimentally isolated
go_no_go.descriptor: analog fails positive trivial skill or topology accuracy .5 in >=4 folds AND high range extrapolation; compatible evidence, not proof
go_no_go.next_stage: STEP5E recommendations only; STOP after STEP5D
